# termux-android-agent-kit

> Agentic-friendly skill & CLI toolkit for offline multilingual voice dictation (whisper.cpp), microphone capture, Wireless ADB, and Android app launching from Termux (non-rooted Android 14-16 / HyperOS / MIUI).

## Core Entrypoints
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Universal instructions and verification commands for AI coding agents.
- [README.md](README.md): Human and agent overview, setup, and usage guide.
- [.agents/skills/termux-android-mic-adb/SKILL.md](.agents/skills/termux-android-mic-adb/SKILL.md): Cross-agent skill runbook (Antigravity, Codex, Hermes, Claude Code).
- [.agents/skills/termux-android-mic-adb/scripts/check_env.sh](.agents/skills/termux-android-mic-adb/scripts/check_env.sh): Non-destructive environment check (`--json` supported).

## CLI Tools & Examples
- [install.sh](install.sh): Idempotent installer supporting `--dry-run`, `--skill-only`, `--bin-only`, `--all`.
- [bin/dictate](bin/dictate): Multilingual voice dictation CLI (offline `whisper.cpp` via `--offline` or Android `termux-speech-to-text`).
- [bin/vdict](bin/vdict): Short wrapper for `dictate --offline`.
- [bin/voice-tui](bin/voice-tui): Floating `tmux display-popup` dictation into any active TUI pane.
- [examples/tmux-voice.conf](examples/tmux-voice.conf): Drop-in `tmux` bindings (`Alt+v`, `Prefix+v`).
- [examples/termux-extra-keys.properties](examples/termux-extra-keys.properties): One-tap `VOICE` extra key for Termux.
